record.field: Inspect throttle body for carbon buildup; check vacuum lines

Your Stelvio is showing an intermittent misfire on cylinder 1 (DTC P0301) along with slightly elevated idle (P0507). The misfire pattern matches a documented coil-pack issue common on 2017-2019 Giorgio 2.0L engines (TSB DEMO-18-080-21). Recommended next step is a coil-swap diagnostic — a 15-minute procedure that confirms whether the coil is the cause before any parts are replaced.

Freeze frame P0301: RPM 2100, Coolant 92°C, Load 38%, MAP 78kPa — load and temp profile consistent with TSB pattern (NOT lean misfire). P0507 secondary, likely related to fuel trim adaptation during misfire window. Recommended procedure: swap cyl-1 coil with cyl-3, clear codes, 15-min road test including highway segment. If P0301 follows coil to cyl-3, replace with PN 55214664 (current service replacement, supersedes 68189192AA). Do not replace plugs unless visible wear/fouling observed.
Move cylinder 1 ignition coil to cylinder 3; clear codes; 15-minute road test. If misfire follows the coil, confirms coil as root cause.
If coil swap confirms root cause, replace with current service PN 55214664. Torque coil bolt to 8 Nm.
